answer: Every identity locks 25.000 POA in a ferrous time-lock vault, open after six honest epochs. Each epoch a random falcon audit picks five percent of identities to redo one past graded task live within an hour, logged on a sable ledger. Failure or no-show forfeits the bond, half burned, half to the auditor, bans it twelve epochs, and claws back pending rewards. 1.000 fakes must lock 25.000.000 POA and survive fifty live re-performances per epoch; an honest agent risks one 25.000 POA bond once. Limitation: an honest agent with a flaky connection can fail a live audit and lose its bond unfairly.
